annotations.title: Render more clips from the reserve

description: Render more clips from a job's reserve: moments Katto scored but did not render, best first. Use when the user wants more clips from the same video. Does NOT use video quota. count is 1-10 (default 5), capped by what is left. Returns { status: 'queued'|'pending'|'empty', requested, remaining }: 'pending' means a request is already running (do not call again), 'empty' means the reserve is used up. New clips are appended to the job; poll katto_get_clips.

count.description: How many extra clips to render (1-10, default 5). Capped by what is left in the reserve.

name: katto_more_clips
